iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

PROFILE::antifraud
       Returns the value of a ANTIFRAUD profile setting.

SYNOPSIS
       PROFILE::antifraud ATTR

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in the assigned ANTIFRAUD profile.

RETURN VALUE
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in the assigned ANTIFRAUD profile.

VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
